messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SEV2 paging — latency SLO breach on streaming alpha model (prod, eu-west1). p95/p99 balloons since 04:12 UTC, alerts firing. PagerDuty: PD#INC-2039
Maya: seeing same. p99 spike coincides with a calibration rollout at ~04:00.
Devon: attaching quick queries — 5m snapshot:
```
# prom queries
redwood_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=\"runtime\",model=\"alpha-stream\"} -> p95 ~ 0.82s -> 0.32s baseline, p99 ~ 2.3s -> baseline 0.45s
streaming_chunks_per_req increased 3x
errors total ~0.6% (timeout/retry)
```
Maya: streaming stalls reported by SDK teams, clients seeing partial streams and long tails. CS flagged three customers experiencing degraded UX.
Sandeep: we pushed a precision profile change (fp8 calibration) to alpha-stream pool at 04:00 as part of the rollout. Calib job rewrote per-layer scales; suspect fallout.
Pooja: can we revert the profile for the pool? rollback policy exists but needs manual kick because of rolling calibration state.
Runtime Bot: Autoscaler/placement stable. No GPU OOMs. KV cache hit rate dropped ~20% on affected hosts.
Devon: hypothesis: calibration introduced a microcode path causing slower dequant / KV interactions — increases per-token latency and adds jitter for streaming. p99 impact visible on long contexts.
Tom: I'm oncall — taking ownership. Steps: 1) isolate affected pool 'alpha-prod-04' 2) route 100% traffic off to fallback variant 3) rollback precision profile to last-known-good 4) disable calibration job.
Maya: routing now -> command: `/route set alpha-stream alpha-prod-04 -> alpha-stream-fallback`
Runtime Bot: route update accepted. 6 hosts drained, new traffic hitting fallback pool.
Pooja: starting rollback: `profiles apply --pool alpha-prod-04 --profile int8-stable --force`
Sandeep: stopping calibration cron (disabled for alpha group).
Devon: monitoring changes — p95 trending down: 320ms -> 150ms. p99 dropping but still elevated: 2.3s -> 0.7s.
Julia (CS): Customer comms drafted: "We're investigating latency spikes; mitigation in progress. Expect improved latency within 15-30 minutes. We'll follow up." Want me to send to the three affected accounts?
Maya: yes send an interim note. include incident id PD#INC-2039 and link to status page.
Tom: additional mitigation: clear KV cache on drained hosts and pre-warm caches on fallback. `kvctl flush --hosts drained-alpha-04 && kvctl prewarm --hosts fallback-alpha`
Runtime Bot: KV flush acknowledged. Prewarm started. Cache hit rate recovering.
Devon: after full rollback and prewarm: p95 140ms, p99 320ms, errors back to baseline 0.08%. Streaming chunk timeouts gone.
Sandeep: root cause postmortem draft: regression in fp8 calibration mapper for layer groups with mixed size -> introduced extra memcpy + slow path in dequant code path under certain input length distributions. Repro locally on long-context tests.
Maya: action items: 1) revert config rollback guard (make calib job require manual approval) 2) add canary to measure p50/p95/p99 on long-context streaming before rollout 3) add automated rollback if p99 > 1s for 10m 4) postmortem and customer impact report.
Pooja: created rollback runbook note: https://console/internal/runbooks/alpha-precision-rollback (draft).
Tom: handing off to next oncall (Devon) — I need to sign off at 05:30 UTC. Monitoring for 30m then update PD.
Devon: ack handoff. Will watch dashboards.
Julia (CS): sent interim messages to customers. One asked for ETA on root cause; I gave preliminary explanation and mitigation summary.
Maya: incident state: mitigated -> traffic routed, profile rolled back, caches warmed. Monitoring stable for 22m. Will keep thread open for postmortem notes. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Incident PD#INC-2039 status changed to MITIGATED by Tom at 05:06 UTC.
